picks.title: Decomp.dev shuts down: 'The community aspect of decompilation has been broken' by low-effort AI slop
picks.rationale: A major community tool is closing because of the flood of AI decomps and ports. Earlier cards covered the AI-port wave; this is the first time core infrastructure has shut down over it.
picks.excerpt: Developer Luke 'encounter' Street is closing decomp.dev, the site that tracked human-driven decompilations of classic games, citing the flood of low-effort AI decomps and ports.

picks.title: Sega's Total War: Shogun 2 Remake Is Such A Disaster It's Being Pulled From Sale
picks.rationale: A follow-up with a new publisher decision. Sega and Creative Assembly pulled the AI-upscaled edition two days after launch and restored the 2011 original, which turns the backlash into a delisting.
picks.excerpt: Sega and Creative Assembly pulled the AI-upscaled Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition from sale two days after launch following backlash over AI art and bugs, and restored the original 2011 version.

picks.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark (ACE Nemotron 3.5 Bolt SLM in SkyrimNET, RTX Remix ComfyUI v2)
picks.rationale: Two concrete tool releases: a 4GB on-device NPC model shipping Oct. 23 in SkyrimNET, and RTX Remix 1.6 with ComfyUI v2 texture generation. Of these picks, it is the one modders can act on most directly.
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA's third-gen ACE game-character SLM, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, arrives Oct. 23 inside SkyrimNET's unscripted AI NPC mod, and RTX Remix 1.6 overhauls AI texture generation with ComfyUI v2.

picks.title: Battlefield 6 Gets Slammed For More Slop Slipping Through: 'Charging Players $$$ For AI-Generated Content Is Peak Disrespect'
picks.rationale: Players found AI artifacts in paid cosmetics for a major AAA game. It shows that monetized assets get the strictest scrutiny for AI generation.
picks.excerpt: Paid Battlefield 6 operator cosmetics with five-fingered-gun artifacts and misspelled patches have players accusing EA of selling AI-generated content.

picks.title: After 8 years, Ultima creator says his MMO Shroud of the Avatar finally has 'zero bugs' thanks to AI
picks.rationale: A veteran developer reports that AI cleared a live MMO's bug backlog and cut the team and time it needs. It is a concrete production claim, not a general opinion.
picks.excerpt: Richard Garriott says AI bug-fixing cleared Shroud of the Avatar's backlog and that 'we need fewer people and less time to make it' because of AI.

https://kotaku.com/sega-total-war-shogun.new_action: Sega/Creative Assembly pulled the AI-upscaled Shogun 2 Complete Edition from sale and restored the original 2011 version (publisher decision after the 10-15 backlash card).
